messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: fitted model with DOF == 0
parts:
Hi Sergio,

Guesstimates don't have CIs or DOFs because the model hasn't been fit to the data yet.

Regarding the error model selection, I would also check that the numbers are plausible for GPS error (usually 4-20 meters with DOP or 15-30 without). You only had one calibration deployment/location?

Best,
Chris

newbie acting as a newbie, my bad!  Is much better when the uncertainty lays at my side. :-)

I have 4 calibration deployment sets at 4 different locations, something about 30 fixes each one, sampled along 2 - 4 days. One set is very diversified and other 3 are more stable from the DOP perspective. Should I improve this calibration dataset with more different deployment locations? Also, I have others datasets collected during few minutes/hours. I avoided put these short samples together with 2-4 samples.

Many thanks,

Sergio.

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: fitted model with DOF == 0
parts:
Hi Sergio,

Your previous output seemed to indicate that the 4 deployments are identified as 1. Make sure that you are doing error model selection on a list of telemetry objects—each corresponding to one deployment / fixed location. You can include additional small samples if necessary to tease apart model performance or get better estimates. The error parameter estimates are relatively ideal, and smaller samples are not a problem.

Best,
Chris
